title: Say exactly what an absent initial sighting predicts when the sighting read is taken before the run-feed head
outcome: Say exactly what an absent initial sighting predicts when the sighting read is taken before the run-feed head
acceptance: behavioral-control-plane.md says a bound root with an absent sighting predicts the no_initial_sighting refusal only when read_cut equals head_cut, or when nothing recorded after the cut moves the basis. For an earlier cut, recording can first refuse as basis moved (a check recorded or a source change after the cut).
A test records an evaluation at an earlier cut after a later host check and asserts the basis-moved refusal, while the read at that cut reads absent.

The docs say that a finished run can read bound here while named_root_read and session status report none for it, because the read uses recording's selection and recording evaluates only the item's active run.
